back: A coil, usually on a soft-iron core, that is magnetised only while a current flows.

front: Why use an electromagnet on a scrap-yard crane?
back: It can be switched off to drop the load, and its strength can be varied.
Compasses, loudspeakers, microphones, dynamos, motors, door catches, magnetic storage.
Cranes, metal sorting, electric bells, relays, circuit breakers, door locks.

front: How does an electric bell keep ringing?
back: The attracted armature breaks the contact, switching off the magnet; a spring pulls it back and the cycle repeats.
Lets a small current in its coil switch a separate circuit carrying a large current.
